entries.name: Deadly Aspects
entries.descriptionTemplate: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a $s1% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by $6150s1% for $6150d. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a $s2% chance of increasing melee attack speed by $1299448s1% for $1299448d.

entries.name: Endurance Training
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by $s1%.

entries.name: Focused Fire
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by $s1% while your pet is active.

entries.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by $s1%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

entries.name: Pathfinding
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Revive Pet
entries.descriptionTemplate: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by $/1000;s1 sec, mana cost is reduced by $s2%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional $s3%.

entries.name: Bestial Swiftness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the movement speed of your pets by $s1%.

entries.name: Unleashed Fury
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Mend Pet
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Mend Pet spell a $s1% chance of cleansing $24406s1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by $s2%.

entries.name: Ferocity
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by $s1%.

entries.name: Summon Hawk
entries.descriptionTemplate: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing ${$s1+($rap*($s4/100))} Physical damage and continuing its assault for $1293248d. Only $s3 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

entries.name: Spirit Bond
entries.descriptionTemplate: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate $m1% of total health every $m2 sec.

entries.name: Intimidation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Command your pet to Stun the target for $24394d on its next successful attack, which also gains $m2% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

entries.name: Bestial Discipline
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by $s1% and allows $m2% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your pet a $s1% chance to gain a $19615s1% attack speed increase for $19615d after dealing a critical strike.

entries.name: Bestial Wrath
entries.descriptionTemplate: Send your pet into a rage causing $s2% additional damage for $d.  While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

entries.name: Hawk Eye
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by $s1 yards.

entries.name: Improved Concussive Shot
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Concussive Shot a $m1% chance to stun the target for $19410d.

entries.name: Lethal Attacks
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Stings
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increased the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by $s1%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by ${$m2/-1000} sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by ${$m3/1000} sec.

entries.name: Efficiency
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Careful Aim
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Attack Power by $s1% of your Intellect.

entries.name: Rapid Killing
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by ${$m1/-60000} min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within $415407d by $m2%.

entries.name: Improved Arcane Shot
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by $/1000;S1 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

entries.name: Lone Wolf
entries.descriptionTemplate: You deal $s2% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

entries.name: Trueshot Aura
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within $a1 yards by $s1. Lasts $d.

entries.name: Mortal Shots
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by $m1%.

entries.name: Rapid Recuperation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Hitting a target with your Serpent Sting ability grants you $s1% and consuming Rapid Killing grants you $s2% of your Mana regeneration while casting for the next $1242512d.

entries.name: Barrage
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Scatter Shot
entries.descriptionTemplate: A short-range shot that deals $s1% weapon damage and disorients the target for $d.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.  Turns off your attack when used.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by $s1%.

entries.name: Sniper Shot
entries.descriptionTemplate: A steady snipe that increases ranged damage by $s1.

entries.name: Improved Serpent Sting
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Tracking
entries.descriptionTemplate: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by $m1%.

entries.name: Deflection
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Parry chance by $s1%.

entries.name: Entrapment
entries.descriptionTemplate: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for ${$m1/1000} sec.

entries.name: Savage Strikes
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Survivalist
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your total Health by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Wing Clip
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Wing Clip ability a $s1% chance to immobilize the target for $19229d.

entries.name: Clever Traps
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by $s1% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by $s2%.

entries.name: Surefooted
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your hit chance by $m3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by $m2%.

entries.name: Deterrence
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by $s1% for $d.

entries.name: Survival Tactics
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Predator's Edge
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your melee critical strike damage by $s1% and your offhand weapon damage by $s2%.

entries.name: Counterattack
entries.descriptionTemplate: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals $s2% weapon damage plus $m1 and immobilizes the target for $d. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

entries.name: Resourcefulness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Trap abilities and melee abilities by $s1%. In addition, your critical strikes have a $m3% chance to allow $1242688s1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for $1242688d.

entries.name: Expose Prey
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a $s1% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for $5302d.

entries.name: Survivalist's Discipline
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by $m%.

entries.name: Strider Kick
entries.descriptionTemplate: A powerful kick that deals $s2% melee weapon damage.

entries.name: Lightning Reflexes
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Agility by $s1%.

entries.name: Lacerating Strikes
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage over $1310536d equal to $s1% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite.

entries.name: Lightning Reflexes
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Agility by $s1%.
